title: Water Damage Mitigation Insurance Billing Worksheet: The Insured's Share
content:
## Insurance billing worksheet — Water Damage Mitigation

**Clause.** The insured's share of a job is the part of its charges that the claim's dwelling coverage does not pay and that the insured pays the company directly. The insured's own finance charges are the total of the job's card surcharge and late fee lines, which insurance proceeds never pay. Lead-safe setup and asbestos sampling are paid by the dwelling coverage only through the linked claim file's ordinance or law coverage: the amount by which the job's lead-safe setup and asbestos sampling lines total more than the code work covered is a non-covered amount, and nothing is non-covered for them when that total is not above the code work covered. The code work covered is the claim file's ordinance or law limit, taken as zero when the file carries no limit. Moving contents within rooms is covered for one room for every block of affected floor area, rounded up, the block being 400 square feet; the rooms on the job's contents manipulation lines above the covered rooms, priced at the tier's contents manipulation rate per room, are a non-covered amount. Non-covered amounts are billed to the insured only on a claim file whose billing arrangement lets a line the carrier declines be billed to the customer; on an arrangement that never bills such a line to the customer, no non-covered amount enters the share, as the claims charter provides for Assignment of Benefits and Carrier Program files. The insured's share is the insured's finance charges plus every non-covered amount that applies to the job, rounded to the cent, half up, and never more than the job's balance due; when the balance due or that amount is zero or less nothing is paid.

## Worksheet lines
| Line | Records read |
|---|---|
| Finance charges | the job's card surcharge and late fee lines |
| Regulated materials | the job's lead-safe setup and asbestos sampling lines; the claim file's ordinance or law limit |
| Contents manipulation | the rooms on the job's contents manipulation lines; the affected floor area; the tier's contents manipulation rate |
| Billability | whether the claim file's billing arrangement lets a declined line be billed to the customer |
| Cap | the job's balance due |

## Worked figure (hypothetical job)
Assumed for illustration: card surcharge lines $12.00 and late fee lines $30.00; lead-safe setup $500.00 and asbestos sampling $450.00 against an ordinance or law limit of $600.00; affected floor area 900 square feet with contents manipulation lines for 5 rooms at an assumed $70.00 per room; an arrangement that lets declined lines be billed to the customer; balance due $1000.00.
1. Finance charges: $42.00.
2. Regulated materials: $950.00 is $350.00 more than the $600.00 covered, so $350.00 is non-covered.
3. Contents: 900 divided by 400 is 2.25, rounded up to 3 covered rooms; 2 rooms above them at $70.00 give $140.00 non-covered.
4. Share: $42.00 plus $350.00 plus $140.00, that is $532.00, which is below the $1000.00 balance due, so $532.00.

On an arrangement that never bills a declined line to the customer, the same job's share is the finance charges alone, $42.00; and with a balance due of $400.00 on the billable arrangement, the share would be held to $400.00.
